component.name: Pulsares Explorer
component.summary: Fast file explorer with tabs, terminal, Studio Editor and DB Studio
Explorador de arquivos rápido com abas, terminal, Studio Editor e DB Studio

description.p: Pulsares Explorer is a fast, lightweight and cross-platform desktop file explorer with tabs, dual pane, integrated terminal, a built-in code editor (Pulsares Studio) and a SQLite manager (Pulsares DB Studio).

O Pulsares Explorer é um explorador de arquivos desktop rápido, leve e multiplataforma, com abas, painel duplo, terminal integrado, editor de código (Pulsares Studio) e gerenciador SQLite (Pulsares DB Studio).

ul.li: Tabs, dual pane, breadcrumbs and progressive folder zoom
Integrated terminal, clipboard history and network drives (SMB, NFS, AFP, SFTP)
Connected cloud integration (OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, Nextcloud, Rclone and more)
Pulsares Studio Editor with live HTML/Markdown preview, PDF and media viewers
Pulsares DB Studio to create, browse and edit SQLite databases
